_comment: Golden SAPMS MESSAGE server-list response frame. Source: captures/phase03_msgserver_capture_output.txt, the MS->CLIENT 598-byte frame (server-list response). Captured 2026-06-27 against SAP A4H Rel. 758, sysnr=00. All field offsets are relative to byte 0 = first byte of the NI 4-byte length prefix (i.e. the buffer stored in .bin includes the 4-byte prefix).

frame_header._comment: SAPMS MESSAGE frame header bytes 0..117. wire-captured.

ni_length_prefix._note: BE uint32 = total frame size - 4. wire-captured.

key_byte._note: [ASSUMED] purpose unknown. Zero in this frame. wire-captured value.

padding_byte_17._note: [ASSUMED] zero padding between version and sender_type. wire-captured value.

sender_name.value: 39 space chars + 0x00 null byte = 40 bytes total
sender_name._note: 40-byte null-terminated sender name field (space-padded + null). Empty (spaces+null) in server responses. wire-captured.

msg_type._note: [ASSUMED] message type. 0x03 = MSG_SERVER class (server-list response). wire-captured.

opcode_padding._note: [ASSUMED] space padding after opcode name to fill field. wire-captured pattern.

opcode_field._note: [ASSUMED] opcode / sub-type field. Value 0x0500 in server-list response. wire-captured value.

sub_opcode._note: [ASSUMED] sub-opcode or response flags. wire-captured value.

_entry_count_note: [ASSUMED] 3 entries derived from (598 - 118) / 160 = 3.0. No explicit count field identified in header — count is inferred by parsing entries until buffer end. wire-captured byte math.

per_server_entry_layout._comment: Per-server entry field layout (offsets relative to entry start). Entry size = 160 bytes. wire-captured from 3 entries in frame.

instance_name._note: 40-byte space-padded ASCII instance name (e.g. 'vhcala4hci_A4H_00') or '-' padded. wire-captured.

hostname_string._note: 40-byte space-padded ASCII hostname or dotted IPv4 string. wire-captured.

field3_unknown._note: [ASSUMED] secondary name / FQDN / 'tick-port' string or '-' padding. wire-captured values.

zeros_120._note: [ASSUMED] 4 space bytes (0x20) then zero bytes leading to ffff marker. wire-captured pattern.

load_byte._note: [ASSUMED] server load score (0 = not participating, 0xBB=187 = active with load). wire-captured for entry2=0xBB. Entry1 and entry3 have 0x00.

ffff_marker._note: [ASSUMED] fixed 0xFFFF marker before binary IP block. wire-captured in all 3 entries.

ip_addr_primary._note: 4-byte BE IPv4 address. wire-captured: entry0=c0a86306, entry1=c0a85807, entry2=7f000001.

ip_addr_secondary._note: [ASSUMED] duplicate/secondary IP — identical to primary in all 3 entries. wire-captured.

port._note: 2-byte BE port number. 0 = inactive; 0x0C80 = 3200 (active dispatcher). wire-captured.

trailing_flags._note: [ASSUMED] trailing bytes: entry1 byte[0]=0x01 (active flag?), rest zeros. wire-captured values.

server_entries._note: wire-captured: port 0 = not participating in group logon.
wire-captured: loopback entry, inactive for external clients.

selection_rule._note: Select first entry with port > 0 (active). For Phase 4 MVP, this selects entry index 1 (192.168.88.7:3200, sysnr=0). Pool selection deferred to Phase 5.

error_code_field._note: [ASSUMED] No confirmed error code field in this frame. The parser rejects frames with wrong magic or too-short buffer. A SAPMS error response has not been captured — error code location is UNKNOWN. parse_sapms_server_list raises ValueError if magic is wrong; no error-code byte check possible without further RE.
